views.markdown:
Full-featured mod menu for **Minecraft PE Bedrock v1.26.52**.

Floating 8-tab draggable UI injected at runtime via ElleKit.

### Player
- Fly + speed slider, No Clip, God Mode, No Fall Damage
- Super Jump, Infinite Jump, Anti-Knockback, No Slowdown
- Infinite Items, Fast Ladder, Always Day

### Combat
- Kill Aura + range slider, Multi-Aura (N targets)
- Velocity Hack, Trigger Bot, Aim Assist
- Reach Extend, Critical Hits, Anti-Aim, Auto Armour

### Visual
- ESP (Players / Mobs / Items / Chests), Player Health Bars
- X-Ray, Cave ESP, Nametags Through Walls, Tracer Lines
- Fullbright, No Fog, FPS Counter, Coordinates, Mini Radar

### World
- Creative Mode, Insta-Break, No Clip Blocks, Scaffold
- Time of Day slider (0–24000), Clear / Rain / Thunder

### Items
- 12-button quick-give grid (Diamond/Netherite gear, Elytra, Totem, etc.)
- Custom item ID spawn, count stepper, Fill Hotbar / Fill All
- Repair All, Drop All, Keep Inventory, Stack Extend
- Enchant ID + level + Apply / Max All Enchants

### Players
- Live player list with per-player: TP to, TP here, Launch, Set on Fire
- TP All Here, Set All on Fire, Kill All Players
- Auto-TP to target, Freeze Target, Spam Inventory, Crash Target

### Grief
- Nuke (break blocks in radius), Auto-TNT
- Fill Sphere (custom block ID + radius), Flood Water / Lava
- Lightning Strike button, Kill All Mobs, Anti-Grief

### Misc
- No Hunger, Auto Respawn, Sprint Always, Auto Fish
- Anti-AFK, Chat Spam, Silent Swing, No Camera Sway

- Initial release
- 8-tab floating mod menu: Player, Combat, Visual, World, Items, Players, Grief, Misc
- 60+ toggles and sliders
- Live item spawner with quick-give grid and enchant applier
- Per-player action rows in Players tab
- Grief suite: nuke, fill sphere, flood, auto-TNT, lightning
- FPS counter + coordinate HUD
- Draggable menu card and floating FW button
- Dopamine rootless + ElleKit compatible
